name: dataset-card
title: Dataset review card
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Review status
sections.sql: select code,owner,due_on,status,reviewers,answer_sets from review_queue where project_id=$1 order by code

name: adjudication-record
title: Adjudication evidence record
for_each: select id,code from items order by code

sections.title: Annotation history
sections.sql: select actor,labels,rationale,guideline_version,created_at from annotations where item_id=$1 order by sequence

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select actor,labels,rationale,item_revision,guideline_version,created_at from decisions where item_id=$1 order by sequence

name: release-manifest
title: Training release manifest
for_each: select id,code from releases order by code

sections.title: Frozen examples
sections.sql: select e->>'code' code,e->>'source' source,e->>'external_id' external_id,e->>'content' content,e->>'labels' labels,e->>'reviewer' reviewer from releases r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.payload) e where r.id=$1
